samples.summary: New Remove-link toolbar button has no test at all (render, wiring, or default-off)
samples.evidence: The delta adds a `showRemoveLink` branch rendering a `ToolbarButton` (aria-label "Remove link") wired to `editor.removeLink?.(); editor.focus()`, and opts it in from `text-edit-section.tsx:93` and `mobile-toolbar.tsx:580`. By the PR's own rationale this button is the ONLY way a slides user can drop an href (slides has no link popover, and Clear formatting now preserves links). No test exercises it: `packages/frontend/tests/components/text-formatting/text-format-toggles.test.ts` renders `TextFormatGroup` with jsdom + react-dom/client but only covers Bold/Italic/Underline/Strikethrough and never passes `showRemoveLink`; `tests/app/slides/toolbar/mobile-text-toggles.test.ts` mounts `MobileSlidesToolbar` but only asserts the B/I/U trio on the bar (the Format sheet holding the group is not opened); `tests/app/slides/toolbar/text-edit-section.test.ts` is a state-machine + module-import smoke test and explicitly says JSX rendering is unavailable there, and its structural check (lines 204-217) does not even assert `removeLink` exists. Because `removeLink` is declared OPTIONAL on `TextFormattingEditor` and invoked with `?.`, a wiring/plumbing mistake (surface passes an editor without `removeLink`, or the prop is forgotten) fails silently — the button appears and does nothing — with no lane catching it (frontend has no tsc, and the optional call type-checks regardless).

samples.summary: Collapsed-caret Clear formatting at a link trailing edge is tested only for the keyboard path; the toolbar/EditorAPI path (same scenario) has no test
samples.evidence: The delta fixes `TextEditor.clearFormatting()` (text-editor.ts:3438-3448) so a collapsed caret at a link trailing edge re-arms `href: undefined`, and adds `link-trailing-edge.test.ts:236` covering exactly that via the Mod+\ keydown. The equivalent user action through the toolbar button — `EditorAPI.clearInlineFormatting()` (editor.ts:3344) → `applyStyleImpl(CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE)` — takes a different collapsed-caret branch: `pending.set({ ...getSelectionStyleImpl(), ...style }, cursor.position)` (editor.ts:1170), which seeds from the caret style (the run behind the caret, href included) and, since `CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE` no longer carries `href`, leaves the link's href in the pending style while also discarding any armed `href: undefined`. No test covers that path at a trailing edge: `packages/docs/test/view/editor-clear-formatting.test.ts` only exercises range selections (`selectWholeBlock`) plus `removeLink`, and `link-trailing-edge.test.ts` only drives the keydown. So if the toolbar button silently extends the link on the next typed character, the suite stays green — a user-visible link-content defect on the same behavior this delta claims all three entry points share ('Shares CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE with the toolbar button ... so all three clear exactly the same keys').

samples.summary: Second disjunct of the new `exitsLink` condition (`prev.href === undefined`) is never independently exercised
samples.evidence: `exitsLink = this.isAtLinkTrailingEdge(pos) || !!(prev && 'href' in prev && prev.href === undefined)`. In the added test `link-trailing-edge.test.ts:236`, `insertLink` leaves the caret at the trailing edge, so `isAtLinkTrailingEdge` is already true and the test passes with the second disjunct deleted; the guard test at :252 has both disjuncts false. Nothing covers the case the second clause exists for (pending armed with `href: undefined` at a position that no longer reads as a trailing edge), so that clause is either untested behavior or dead code and the suite cannot tell which.

I also checked the strongest indirect candidate, tests/components/text-formatting/toolbar-focus.test.ts, which renders TextFormatGroup and is exactly where this repo tests analogous flags (showStrikethrough false at 140-145, showHighlight false at 147-154, preventDefault loop at 121-128) — it never mentions the new flag or label. Also searched color-reset.test.ts, all 13 files in tests/components/text-formatting/, all tests/app/slides/toolbar/*, the visual harness (slides-scenarios.tsx:1680 supplies removeLink but no harness test exists), all *.spec.* files (backend only), and scripts/hunt-ui-dom.mjs (an exploratory agent DOM reader, not a test). The only adjacent coverage is editor-side: packages/slides/test/view/editor/text-box-editor.test.ts:740 asserts typeof removeLink === 'function', which does not cover the button's render, click wiring, or default-off. Blocking as major under the test-adequacy rubric: a new user-facing control that is the sole path to drop an href on slides, invoked through an optional call so a plumbing miss ships as a silently dead button.

verdict.reason: The finding is accurate and blocking under the test-adequacy lens. The toolbar path (EditorAPI.clearInlineFormatting, editor.ts:3344-3350 -> applyStyleImpl collapsed branch at editor.ts:1167-1174) takes a genuinely different code path from the keyboard path (TextEditor.clearFormatting, text-editor.ts:3426-3454, reached only from the Mod+\ keydown at text-editor.ts:1241), and only the keyboard path re-arms href: undefined at a link trailing edge. caretInlineStyle (model/caret-style.ts:59-81) returns the link run's style (href included) at a trailing edge, so the toolbar seed carries href; exitLinkIfAtTrailingEdge is only called on Enter/space/etc. (text-editor.ts:981, 2608, 2641, 4171), never per typed character, so nothing downstream re-arms the exit. I enumerated every clearInlineFormatting() call site in the repo: editor-clear-formatting.test.ts:105/176/224/256 all use range selections (selectWholeBlock at 154-163, explicit ranges at 100-103 and 227-230); editor-on-cursor-move.test.ts:168 uses a range and asserts only callback fan-out; text-box-clear-formatting.test.ts:115/129 use selectAll and a different implementation (text-box-editor.ts:1081); text-box-editor.test.ts:45 is a no-selection "does not throw" smoke test; all frontend/slides hits are vi.fn()/noop mocks. link-trailing-edge.test.ts:236-264 drives only the keydown helper (lines 124-136); text-box-link-trailing-edge.test.ts covers only space/Enter (116/126/137); no test passes CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE through editor.applyStyle (test hits are only model/document.test.ts:161/191); there is no e2e suite. No counterexample exists. Impact if wrong: the toolbar button silently extends the hyperlink over the next typed characters -> user-visible link-content defect shipping green, hence major.
